**Finding submitted: deviation (Section 14.2).**

- **Compliant parts:** §13.1 extends the Services grant to Customer, its Affiliates and contractors; §13.2 gives a perpetual, irrevocable, paid-up licence for delivered/embedded Vendor Technology; §13.3 permits transfer to an Affiliate or successor and limits revocation to uncured material breach after notice and cure. These meet or exceed the preferred position.
- **The failure:** §14.2's Deliverable licence is "revocable, non-transferable," runs to Customer alone (no Affiliates or contractors), and lapses with the Order Form term — walk-away territory and short of the fallback.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** replaces the second sentence of §14.2 with a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, fully paid licence for Customer, its Affiliates and contractors, transferable to an Affiliate or M&A successor, revocable only per §13.3. Vendor's ownership of Deliverables is untouched, so this is the minimal edit to reach the preferred position.
